tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Read the Machine Inbox service instructions: pricing, payment rails, endpoints, and limits.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Request a new paid inbox. Buying requires an out-of-band payment (Stripe MPP or x402 USDC on Base); this tool returns the live HTTP 402 payment challenge plus exact instructions to complete the purchase. Standard inbox: $2.00.

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: Read an inbox: address, status, expiry, limits, and usage.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List messages in an inbox, newest first. Pass after=<newest createdAt seen> to poll for only new mail.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Fetch one message with parsed text, HTML, and attachment download URLs.

tools.name: get_verification_code
tools.description: Extract the newest one-time verification code or confirmation link from inbound mail. Ideal for signup and login flows.

tools.name: reply_to_message
tools.description: Send an included plain-text reply to the authenticated sender of an inbound message.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Register or replace the inbox webhook: an HMAC-signed POST fires on every inbound message with metadata, extracted verification codes, and injection risk (never the body). Returns the signing secret.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Read the inbox webhook state: URL, delivery counters, and whether it is disabled. The secret is only returned by set_webhook.

tools.name: delete_inbox
tools.description: Delete an inbox: revokes the token and erases stored mail.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "set_webhook" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service_info, get_inbox, list_messages, get_message, get_webhook · Private data: set_webhook, get_webhook, delete_inbox · Public sink: reply_to_message, set_webhook, get_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_webhook, delete_inbox.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service_info, get_inbox, list_messages, get_message, get_webhook · Private data: set_webhook, get_webhook, delete_inbox · Public sink: reply_to_message, set_webhook, get_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_webhook, delete_inbox

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
